fieldNotes.facility: Niagara Bottling Frederickson plant, 19820 57th Ave E, Puyallup WA. ~311,000 sq ft plant opened 2014, expanded multiple times. Confirmed by three large water-treatment silos on the building's east face in Street View (2024-05).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck yard is enclosed by a black chain-link perimeter fence with a sliding gate across the truck entry drive on the NE side (clearly visible in Street View 2024-05); a truck is shown passing through the gate, with yellow bollards channeling the lane.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A canopy/check-in structure stands beside the gate drive, but no traditional multi-window manned guard booth is visible.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Controlled sliding gate with a canopy check-in point and no manned booth implies kiosk / automated / remote check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door row along the full north face with many trailers backed in, plus a separate dock bank on the south face; estimated ~42 doors total. Approximate, flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple rows of parked trailers in the north truck yard - a substantial dedicated drop yard.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically separate dock clusters - a large bank on the north face and a smaller bank on the south face - suggesting separate ship/receive operations. Flagged as inferred.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved truck yard and gate apron with unused width; room to add an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Frederickson industrial corridor SE of Tacoma - dense metro-edge industrial fabric with adjacent large warehouses - Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single large Niagara building; the dark-roofed buildings to the east and the RV/equipment storage yard to the north are separate properties.
